reviews.t: It works, but you have to be careful where you use it.
reviews.x: My experience with this stuff is a little humorous. The first thing to note is the instructions are under the barcode sticker. A second thing to note is that even though this stuff is supposedly made in the US, the English on the bottle is not the clearest.  I followed the instructions and soaked my feet first. To make things a little easier, I went ahead and used a shaver on some of the larger calluses. Then, I went in with the callus remover. My bright idea was to sit on the edge of the tub an

reviews.t: It made my feet smooth again!
reviews.x: I have dry skin and callus on my feet.  Found this callus remover, so, decided to give it a try. I'm very happy with the result after I used it on my callus, it made my feet so soft and smooth. Recommend this great product!
Only used it once so far, no issues with the product. Just an fyi though. The instructions were behind the barcode sticker

reviews.t: Perfect Product for Home Pedicure During the COVID-19 Pandemic
reviews.x: I haven't had a pedicure since March. Since I get my nails professionally done bi-weekly and a pedicure monthly my hands and feet were looking horrible. I purchased this callus remover based on the reviews. It is excellent! I copied how my salon uses it and it worked perfectly. The dead skin immediately started coming off the sides, heel and top of my foot. I also purchased a callus scraper as well which aided in the removal of the dead skin. My feet look and feel smoother now thanks to this pro

This did not work as advertised. I used as directed 3x and then I even applied it after soaking my feet for an hour and wearing plastic bags. No dice. Still have calluses on the outside of my feet. I will not buy again

I don’t normally brag about how well a product is BUT this one here, I sure can !!! Absolutely great! Ordered yesterday, got it today. Wish I truly took a before pic, dammit ! I put it on with gloves (a must) (and wrapped a lil cling wrap on my feet, optional) since they suggest you keep it on for 30-40 min. Took the cling off and slightly scrub with the pumice. Was worried it was a gimmick but to my surprise my feet look great. I’d ordered a electric callus remover, sending it back since this s

So, I haven’t worn shoes in months while working from home during this pandemic, and the kickboxing I do for exercise just creates callouses, no matter how good my shoes are. I have “Florida feet.” Calloused, corns, that peel and are sometimes painful.  I rarely endorse products, but after one use, I can see and feel the difference. Self-care has become really important to me during these difficult times. Thanks for this product that makes that a bit more effective.

I was embarrassed to show my feet to anybody. I’ve only had ONE pedicure and I was embarrassed. My heels were thick, dry, and calloused. I bought this and used it (please wear gloves as stated). I’m out here wearing flip flops!!!! I’m very satisfied! Edit: I used this in conjunction with a foot file.

[[VIDEOID:8129b7268b7195950eedf5858c73744d]] I never write reviews unless the product does or exceeds what it says it does...this one is the latter..it's amazing. turned my hooves into human feet in seconds saved $50 tbat i was about to spend AGAIN on a pedicure that kept leaving the callous

I was nervous about it, given the warning to use protective gloves. I had a spot on my foot, so I used a q-tip to apply this product to it, waited 4 minutes. It softened and I was able to remove it with one of the callus shavers. I might reapply in a month just to be sure.
I had ruff feet the product worked it just takes 5 minutes for me but my feet was rough I stopped getting pedicures after Covid and needless to say I needed this product

Out of work right now so cannot afford my "every 3 week" pedicures.  I have supination where I walk on the outside of my feet which causes excessive callouses to grow on my heels.  I always use a pumice stone after every shower but have had to have the manicurist use the heel razor. Now, our state has outlawed the use of the razors.  I find using this callous remover does help a lot.  However, if I go too long without getting my heels scraped, the right heel splits open and well...it is very unc

Yooooooo…. When I say…. Baybeeeeee… this stuff for my feet softer than even getting a pedicure… I am blown away!!!! It was so fast. I literally did it during a work meeting. Feet are smooth and supple!!!! Love love love this! I’ve bought a couple of these different brands. THIS is by far the best!  Will buy 100 more times! Best ever!

I will buy again. I haven’t gotten a professional pedicure since pre pandemic. It has been a minute and I was too embarrassed to go without doing some of the work myself. I got this product purely off of the existing reviews and I’m so glad I did. I will definitely buy this again!
The product works well but it didn't come with a pumice stone as advertised.

I had my mom purchase this product for me through her Amazon account. The estimated delivery date was February 3rd, however it arrived January 25th which was the first plus for me. My feet were extremely dry & cracked with this calluses on my big toe as well as on the side of my feet. Because of this I soaked my feet FOR A FULL HOUR! I applied the callous remover, let it sit for 1 minute, then followed up with the callous shaver. I then reapplied a little more callous remover & used a stainless

Perfect for baby smooth feet, honestly better than going to the nail salon! DIY save money and always have smooth feet. Be careful not to get it on other parts of your skin because it does burn & cause irritation.

I typically don’t write reviews because most things do not work for me. I will say that I did not follow the instructions correctly, however, the stuff was amazing. I did not soak my feet like I should have an applied the callus remover directly to my dry feet. I use the pumas stone after 45 seconds and rinsed my feet. I did not have any problems after the hot and use the lotion as directed. The next day my heels were significantly changed. I will continue using this product. If you don’t want t

I paid attention to what the reviews stated and applied this carefully wearing gloves and avoiding soft skin. I left this on the thickest part of the callus for 45 seconds and then washed it off. I didn't think that would be long enough but it sure was! The callus was almost obliterated. It didn't take the whole callus off in the first round but took off about 75 percent. I would recommend this product for sure. Just be careful it's potent!

After one use, the significant callous on my heel is basically gone. I followed directions, used gloves to apply, and set the timer on my phone to rinse when instructed. No issues. Easy to use, effective, and much more affordable than  pedicures every few weeks!

WEAR GLOVES!!! This is a chemical so be careful not to use other any other part but bottom of feet!!! THIS PRODUCT WORKS GREAT, SATURATE ONE FOOT THEN OTHER THEN START SCRUBBING... BE SURE TO RINSE VERY WELL.... WILL BE ORDERING AGAIN

reviews.t: EXTRA STRENGTH for feet.  Works "crazy good!"
reviews.x: The item came in a timely manner.  I FINALLY used it after my shower, & it works crazy good.  However, since it is professional strength, & the instructions state to use gloves.  I did not use gloves.  I carefully put it on my great toes, (wait 30 -45 seconds) then buff the callous.  Did a great job!  In hind sight, It may be advantageous to apply Vasolene to the surrounding skin. It did make the surrounding skin red, but not painful in any way.  The seller may want to include that in their inst

This stuff really works. Read the cautions. I dropped a bit on my leg and didn’t realize until it began to itch about 15 minutes later. I washed it off thoroughly. The next day there was a scab. But it worked as described on my feet.
Came broken and leaking.  Hard to use.  There are other alternatives with better tops
Didn’t work as expected but did work some

claims.text: Most reviewers say the product works well, softening calluses and leaving feet smooth.
Several reviewers note the instructions are hidden behind the barcode sticker.
Some reviewers warn that gloves are needed when applying the product.
A few reviewers say it did not work for them or took longer than expected.
One reviewer reports the advertised pumice stone was missing from the package.
